entry.summary: Secondary sites say Australians enter Curaçao visa-free for short stays (about 90 days); Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten use an online ED (embarkation-disembarkation) card before arrival.
entry.next_check: Confirm on Curaçao's official immigration or ED card site.
